svg.title: GitHub Webhook Processing Platform ? AWS architecture
svg.desc: Official AWS icons from aws.amazon.com/architecture/icons/. Based on repository Terraform; placement schematic, single-AZ RDS, two ECS services.
svg.text: Secure ingestion. Durable handoff. Async delivery.
FastAPI + PostgreSQL | Transactional outbox | ECS Fargate + SQS | Terraform
Public tasks + internet gateway; private database
HTTPS :443 + ACM certificate | attached to both public subnets
SG alb: inbound TCP 443 from internet
SG api: TCP 8000 only from SG alb
Both containers essential; one shared task role
DB subnet group spans both AZs.
SG database: TCP 5432 only from SG api + SG background
SHARED OPERATIONS / ECS STARTUP + RUNTIME SUPPORT
Execution roles inject secrets and ship logs
One-off Fargate task: migrate / create app login / configure demo
Uses a public subnet + SG background; admin credential injected by a separate execution role.
No runtime task role. Normal services cannot retrieve the RDS administrator secret.
Encrypted backend + native .tflock locking in Ohio
Operator Terraform access; outside application root lifecycle
No application data flow to this bucket
FLOW: blue = delivery / HTTPS teal = PostgreSQL purple = security / IAM notes
AZ/task placement schematic / No NAT or interface endpoints / No RDS standby
